#  11227 - Computer Science in Hydroinformatics Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11227 - module is no longer offered from SS 2024**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Computer Science in Hydroinformatics**  |  
|  Informatik im Wasserwesen   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 2 - Environment and Natural Sciences   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. PD Dr.-Ing. habil. Molkenthin, Frank 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Programming skills for hydroinformatics system development and adaptation, understanding of GIS data structures and application concepts in hydroinformatics.  |  
| Contents:  | Software Engineering: basic steps in software engineering for hydroinfomatics software, introduction to programming languages (e.g. R, Java, C++, Python) and basic components, introduction to basic software engineering and implementation tools (e.g. Eclipse, Anaconda, R Studio).Implementation of simple hydroinformatics tools using selected programming languages: river cross-section, time series, linear equation systems, 1D numerical schemes, data analysisCode examples from implementation of graphical user interfaces, data base access, interfacing with standard data formats, multi-threading, interprocess communication, Web technology, open source tools and libraries for hydroinformatics systems.GIS: coordinate reference systems, raster and vector based data structures and operations, digital elevation models (raster, TIN), interfacing, import/export, data bases and data analysis, geo-spatial data analysis, OGC Web-GIS standards, remote sensing, integration in hydroinformatics systems.Application examples from hydroengineering projects.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | No successful participation in associated phase-out module _41416 Computer Skills, Databases and GIS - ICT_.  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 3 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Practical training / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | see https://euroaquae.tu-cottbus.de  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Assignments (20%)
  * Written (120 min) and/or oral (30-45 min) examination (80%)

The form and weighting of partial exams are bindingly determined in the first course weeks.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | EuroAquae module: EA-1.4  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * 240630 Lecture Programming languages and techniques
  * 240631 Exercise Implementation of hydroinformatics tools 
  * 240634 Lecture/Practical training GIS technolgy and interfaces

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
